# Firdavs Tours (demo by fhsystems)

> Firdavs Tours is a demo AI travel consultant built by fhsystems on real 2026 Uzbekistan tour prices. It is a demonstration brand, not a real travel agency: it takes no real bookings and has no real customers.

The demo recommends private and small-group tours across Uzbekistan, quotes exact prices from its 2026 price list, answers practical travel questions, and turns a chat into a booking request with a reference number, in English, Uzbek and Russian. Requests made on this site are demo requests; no trip is booked, sold or paid for.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tours.fhsystems.dev/): the tours, their 2026 prices and common travel questions
- [Planner](https://tours.fhsystems.dev/plan): the AI travel consultant itself (demo)
- [Case study](https://tours.fhsystems.dev/about): what the consultant does for a tour company, how it was tested, and its known limits
